transcript.text: Hi everyone, I'm Leah, the Talent Booker. I've got the draft event plan in front of me for the Mara Vale filmed conversation — 6:20 PM in the Meridian Hall, 45-minute standing interview with audience questions, admission for 600, open photography, and video recording. Before I lock the operational guest package at the daily production meeting, I'd like to hear from each functional lead if there are any changes or updates I need to factor in. What are we looking at?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Leah, I need to flag some important updates from Mara Vale's side. I confirmed with Mara's agent this morning that she is available only from 6:20 PM to 6:55 PM — so 35 minutes, not 45. She requires a seated two-chair interview rather than a standing one, she will not take audience questions, and she will not permit photography. I should also note that the agent's confirmation is still sitting in my inbox and hasn't been entered into the show file yet, so it'll need to be filed as a follow-up.

transcript.text: Leah, I have a critical security update from my post-rehearsal crowd assessment. The safe audience limit for the Meridian Hall is 400 people, not 600. We also need a full front barricade with two unobstructed side exit lanes. The signed assessment is still being attached to the event file, so it'll be a follow-up on the paperwork side.
